description: This file defines a class 'NetworkEnv' for environment-driven network configuration in a Flutter app. It uses flutter_dotenv to load environment variables from a '.env' file, and provides methods to retrieve base URLs for REST and WebSocket connections, with default fallbacks. It also includes a method to check if the app is configured for a real backend.

classes.name: NetworkEnv
classes.description: A class providing environment-based configuration for network endpoints, with methods to load environment variables and access base URLs for REST and WebSocket connections, including fallbacks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads environment variables from the '.env' file exactly once; if the file is missing, falls back silently to defaults.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the value associated with a key from the environment variables, returning an empty string if not found.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for REST API calls, using environment variable 'API_BASE_URL' if set, otherwise defaults to 'http://localhost:8000'.

methods.name: wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL, using 'WS_BASE_URL' if set, otherwise defaults to 'ws://localhost:8000/ws'.

methods.name: isConfiguredForRealBackend
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether either 'API_BASE_URL' or 'WS_BASE_URL' is configured to non-empty values, implying production endpoints.
